title: Turn report
description: The mod's report that an agent's turn started (running true) or completed (running false), sent on a change only (design decision 12). agent_id names the subagent; the main conversation has none. teammate names an in-process agent-team teammate, when the mod API lists the subagent with a teammateId (design decision 4, Origin, plan B); a report without it says nothing of whether the subagent is one, since the list may not hold it.

teammate.description: The teammate's name in its team, as the mod API gives it.
